summary.intent: Implement PR 2 of a stacked series in the callisto repo: a bare-package tag ownership gate in the release flow, with a new diagnostic code, tests, docs/spec updates and a changeset, then link it into a native stack with PR 1.
summary.outcome: Added the ownership gate in tags.rs with a new DiagnosticCode and exact-tag check, plus tests, a mutation check, spec/docs/changeset updates. Fixed fake runners broken by the new git probes, got full CI passing after formatting and a cache-count test fix, then committed, pushed and linked PR 2 to PR 1 via gh stack.

repo: Release --dry-run behavior is tested through existing test helpers; new ownership tests followed that pattern.
New DiagnosticCode variants require registration alongside enum tests in callisto-model/src/diagnostic.rs and must be reflected in the schema guard test and docs/specs/workspace.json.
Fake/recording git runners in callisto-graph tests reject unknown git commands, so adding new git probes in production code breaks those fixtures until the fakes are taught the probes.
Config changes such as previous-tag-templates need updates to docs/config.md, docs/architecture/identity.md, and the spec with WS-ID identifiers.
Full CI runs format, then tests; formatting must be applied and CI rerun before the test recipe result is meaningful.
A changeset is expected for each PR.

code.finding: Home of the bare-package tag ownership gate and exact-tag check added in PR 2.
Release decision code was touched to integrate the ownership gate; fake runners in tests had to be updated for the new probes.
Glob cache count test used a fake runner whose expected git call count broke after the new probes; needed fixing.

workflow: Mutation-checking a new gate (breaking it to confirm tests fail) was used to validate test strength.
Run the crate-level tests early to catch fixture breakage before running full CI.
Stacked PRs are linked using the gh stack extension after pushing the branch.

friction: New git probes broke multiple fake runners in graph tests (changed.rs helper, recording runner, glob cache count test), requiring several rounds of fixes.
Full CI failed first on formatting, then on a cache-count test, causing multiple reruns.
open_items: PR 2 is linked into a stack with PR 1; later PRs in the stack remain.
Line numbers for the code learnings were not available in the transcript.
